children: South Korea's consumer prices rose 3.1% in August from a year earlier, government data showed on Wednesday, coming in below market expectations.
That was faster than the 2.8% rise in July but weaker than a 3.2% increase forecast in a Reuters poll of economists.
The consumer price index rose 0.2% on a monthly basis, after falling 0.2% in the previous month, according to the Ministry of Data and Statistics, while economists had expected a 0.3% rise.
